# All active topics and labels

<!-- Generated by tools/render_taxonomy.py; edit taxonomy.json, then regenerate. -->

Active taxonomy **version 2**: **15 topics** and **27 subtopics**.
The source of truth is [taxonomy.json](../research_notes/taxonomy.json).

This is the complete *controlled subject vocabulary*, not an inventory of
every tag in a personal library. The current schema has two levels, allows
multiple topics, and does not designate a primary topic, research area, or
third-level concept. AI/ML/LLMs currently sit under computer science.

See [classification behavior](CLASSIFICATION.md) and the
[proposed deeper hierarchy and evaluation](CLASSIFICATION-EXPLORATION.md).
The proposal is experimental; it is not the active catalog below.

## Other kinds of labels

- **Source type** is independent of subject: paper, blog, news, video, podcast,
  book, documentation, website, other, unknown. A research paper does not
  automatically receive the subject research.
- **Auto tags** are a separate flat list. Local rules use subtopic names and
  topic names (up to eight tags); the optional model can generate free-text
  tags. Historical results may retain labels from earlier taxonomies.
- **Manual tags and corrections** can use custom labels, outside this catalog.
  Manual corrections take precedence over derived classification.
- **OpenAlex/Semantic Scholar subjects** are externally observed metadata,
  not necessarily members of this local vocabulary.
- **Collections** such as For later, Likes, Liked (Auto), Questions (Auto),
  and Visit Often describe organization/behavior, not subjects.

The model prompt requests catalog subtopics, but the current production
validator checks their parent relationship rather than enforcing every
subtopic name. Therefore this file cannot promise that every previously
generated auto tag or subtopic appears here.

## Exact local rule vocabulary

These phrases are matching triggers, not definitions or synonyms understood
semantically. Matching is case-insensitive, replaces hyphens with spaces,
and uses exact word boundaries; plurals are not expanded automatically.
A title hit or two distinct topic-phrase hits selects a topic. Any subtopic
phrase hit selects that subtopic and its parent. The current limits are
eight topics, twelve subtopics, and eight flat auto tags per page.

## Updating this catalog

From the repository root:

```sh
python3 -B tools/render_taxonomy.py
python3 -B tools/render_taxonomy.py --check
```

Change the JSON source, regenerate this document, and evaluate affected
examples before changing production labels. Renaming/reparenting labels
also needs a migration plan for filters, stored results, and manual edits.
